## cli-cell-and-source-ops

**Governed hosted cell plan/apply and sealed source pull CLI** — status: `implemented` | evidence tier: `runtime-enforced`

### Spec contracts

- `docs/spec/core/06-composition-config.md`
- `docs/spec/core/07-world-boundary.md`

### Linked invariants & gates

- `artifact-governance-lean` (artifact-governance/proof)
- `ontology-mapping-provenance-lean` (ontology/proof)

### Owned surfaces

- `cli:norn cell apply`
- `cli:norn cell plan`
- `cli:norn source pull`
- `cli:norn-ts apply`
- `cli:norn-ts plan`

### Source paths

- `crates/norn-cli/src/cell.rs`
- `crates/norn-cli/src/source.rs`
- `crates/norn-cell-do/src/dev/http.rs`
- `crates/norn-cell-do/tests/hosted_install.rs`
- `tools/norn-ts/src`

### Probe

- **Drive:** Target a provisioned hosted cell / Rivet endpoint with two fresh cell baselines and a scope-matched bearer token per org/env so neither CLI replays an already-installed pack: (1) Rust `norn` (each input file is one artifact envelope): run `norn compile tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --org <org-rust> --env <env-rust> --out <tmp>/artifacts.json`, split that JSON array into one artifact-envelope JSON file per element under `<tmp>/rust-pack/`, then run `norn cell plan --url <hosted-url> --org <org-rust> --env <env-rust> --token-env NORN_HOST_TOKEN_RUST <tmp>/rust-pack` followed by `norn cell apply --url <hosted-url> --org <org-rust> --env <env-rust> --token-env NORN_HOST_TOKEN_RUST <tmp>/rust-pack`; (2) TypeScript `norn-ts` (compiles typed sources directly via `worker.ts`): run `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts plan tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --url <hosted-url> --org <org-ts> --env <env-ts> --token-env NORN_HOST_TOKEN_TS` followed by `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts apply tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --url <hosted-url> --org <org-ts> --env <env-ts> --token-env NORN_HOST_TOKEN_TS`; (3) test `norn source pull --crosswalk-env <VAR> --connector <connector.json> --extracted-at-ms <ms>` against a loopback mock/ERPNext endpoint.
- **Observable end state:** Against each fresh hosted cell baseline, both Rust `norn cell plan` and TS `norn-ts plan` print a non-empty diff proposing `plan.nextVersion` over the observed provisioned baseline without mutating cell state, and `norn cell apply` / `norn-ts apply` atomically install `plan.nextVersion` (replaying the same pack reports `unchanged`); against `norn dev`, both fail closed with `409 defs.dev_sources_only`; `norn source pull` issues GET-only reads (`SRC-READ-1`), binds identity solely via the reviewed crosswalk (`SRC-IDENT-1`), and fails closed on read errors (`SRC-LIVE-1`).
- **Gotchas:**
  - `norn compile` emits a JSON array, whereas `norn cell plan|apply` wraps each input `.json` file as one element of the request `artifacts` array — split compiled output into one artifact-envelope file per element before passing the directory to `norn cell`; `norn-ts plan|apply` compiles typed `.ts` pack/project sources directly.
  - Provisioning already installs baseline revision 1, so assert `plan.nextVersion` over the observed baseline; use a distinct org/env baseline and scope-matched bearer token (`NORN_HOST_TOKEN_RUST` vs `NORN_HOST_TOKEN_TS`) per CLI so the second run does not return `unchanged` or fail org-scope auth.
  - `norn dev` explicitly rejects `/v1/cell/definitions:plan` and `/v1/cell/definitions:apply` with `409 defs.dev_sources_only` (`DEV-ONE-AUTHORITY-1`, `crates/norn-cell-do/src/dev/http.rs`); never target `norn dev` to prove hosted plan/apply.
  - Never pass bearer tokens or passwords directly as CLI arguments; `cell` and `source` intentionally accept `--token-env` / `--crosswalk-env` only.

### Linked invariants & gates

### Source paths

- `crates/norn-cli/src/main.rs`
- `crates/norn-cli/src/explain.rs`
- `crates/norn-checker/src/artifact_set.rs`
- `crates/norn-checker/src/explain.rs`
- `tools/norn-ts/src`

### Probe

- **Drive:** Exercise both CLIs explicitly: (1) Rust `norn`: run `norn check --source tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --org example --env local` (and `--artifacts <json> --context <ctx>`), then `norn explain concept <id> --defs <json> --format json`; (2) TypeScript `norn-ts`: with `NORN_CHECKER_WASM_PKG` set, run `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts check tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --org example --env local`, and inside a `norn.json` project run `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts explain concept <id> --json`.
- **Observable end state:** Both Rust `norn check` and TS `norn-ts check` print a canonical report with `admitted`, diagnostics, and `receiptSha256` without installing definitions; both Rust `norn explain` and TS `norn-ts explain` render the shared `norn/explain@2` JSON/text explanation with honest proof status.
- **Gotchas:**
  - `--artifacts` and `--source` are mutually exclusive in Rust `norn check`; `--org` and `--env` must be passed together or both omitted for `norn.json` projects; TS `norn-ts check` and `norn-ts explain` load the checker ABI via `NORN_CHECKER_WASM_PKG`.

- `crates/norn-cli/src/eval.rs`

- `crates/norn-ir/src/source_tree.rs`

### Probe

- **Drive:** Run `norn openapi` and diff against `sdks/openapi/norn-api.openapi.json`, run `norn source-digest crates/norn-ir`, and run `norn eval --defs <dir> --org <org> --env <env> --rule <id>` over sample JSON-lines stdin.
- **Observable end state:** `norn openapi` matches the checked-in OpenAPI document byte-for-byte; `norn source-digest` returns deterministic `{digest, files}` skipping hidden entries and `target/` while refusing symlinks; `norn eval` evaluates admitted closures within `--units` budget.
- **Gotchas:**
  - `norn source-digest` refuses visible symlinks, sockets/FIFOs, and non-UTF-8 filenames by contract (`HOST-TREE-1`).
